# AppIntents

**Area:** [App extensions & system integration](../COVERAGE.md#system) · **Apple:** [AppIntents](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appintents) · **Issues:** [`area:system`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Asystem)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** the app runs in a metadata mode that reads its conformance records. Siri (text only), Shortcuts and Focus are simulated.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| App Intents (Shortcuts, Siri, Spotlight, interactive widgets, `AppShortcutsProvider`) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: the home screen reads each app's App Shortcuts and intents by starting its executable in a metadata mode (the Swift conformance records; Apple extracts them at build time into Metadata.appintents) and caches them per executable. The system Shortcuts app lists them as tiles (`shortcutTileColor`, symbols), the app's other discoverable intents as Actions, voice shortcuts and donated Siri Suggestions, and runs them; Spotlight lists matching App Shortcuts and runs them; the simulated Siri (`siri PHRASE`, Ctrl+Shift+S; text, no speech recognition) matches App Shortcut phrases (`\(.applicationName)`, `AppEnum` / `AppEntity` parameters from `suggestedEntities()` and `updateAppShortcutParameters()`). Intents run in the app (launched in the background; in the foreground for `openAppWhenRun` / `OpenIntent` / `.result(opensIntent:)`): required `@Parameter`s and `requestValue` / `requestDisambiguation` / `needsValueError` ask (AppEnum cases, entities, Type to Siri), `requestConfirmation` (action names, snippet), result dialogs, values and snippet views (drawn by the app) shown in Siri's card (iOS 17 orb, iOS 18+ glowing edge, Liquid Glass on 26+). `IntentDescription` (search keywords), `isDiscoverable`, `authenticationPolicy` (refused while locked), `SiriTipView`, `ShortcutsLink`; `Button(intent:)` / `Toggle(isOn:intent:)` in apps and interactive widgets. Tested (HelloSiri: test_shortcuts, per iOS version; HelloWidgets). Not in isim: App Intents extensions, parameter summaries, user-built multi-step shortcuts and automations, `EntityPropertyQuery`, Focus filters / controls (other rows). Intents directed to scenes (iOS 26): `TargetContentProvidingIntent` / `UISceneAppIntent` go to the scene whose activation conditions take their `contentIdentifier`, through `AppIntentSceneDelegate.scene(_:willPerformAppIntent:)` or `performNavigation(forScene:)`; `uiScene`, `connectionOptions.appIntent` (tested, HelloSceneLaunch). Onscreen entities: `EntityIdentifier`, `AppEntityAnnotatable`, `AppEntityUIElement` (shown in the view dump). Missing: `@Property` / `EntityProperty`, `@Dependency` / `AppDependencyManager`, `ParameterSummary`, `DynamicOptionsProvider`, `EntityPropertyQuery`, `AppIntentError` |
| Focus and Focus filters (`SetFocusFilterIntent`, `INFocusStatusCenter`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: Do Not Disturb, Personal, Work, Sleep in Control Center's Focus module (icon toggles, title opens the list), Settings › Focus and script `focus MODE\|off`; the Lock Screen shows it. While on, notifications from apps the Focus does not allow (Settings › Focus › Apps) are delivered quietly (Notification Center, no banner); `interruptionLevel` `.timeSensitive` with the time-sensitive entitlement breaks through (per-Focus option). `INFocusStatusCenter` (Intents: `focusStatus.isFocused`, authorization alert, `ISIM_FOCUS_STATUS_PERMISSION`). **Focus filters**: `SetFocusFilterIntent` types are found in the app (Swift conformance records) and listed in Settings › Focus › Focus Filters with their `@Parameter`s (Bool, String, Int, Double, `AppEnum`, optionals); turning the Focus on runs `perform()` in the app with the configured values (a running app, else launched in the background), off runs it with the defaults; `current`; `appContext.notificationFilterPredicate` against `filterCriteria` quiets non-matching notifications. Not on isim: allowed people (no communication notifications), schedules and Focus Lock/Home Screen customization, custom Focus modes, the Focus icon in the status bar. Tested (focus) |
| Control Center controls (`ControlWidget`, `ControlCenter`) | ✅ | 18.0 | adapted (`@available(iOS 18)`, none on iOS 17): `ControlWidget` in a widget extension's `WidgetBundle` (also inside `if #available`) or as `@main`; `StaticControlConfiguration` (with or without a `ControlValueProvider`: `currentValue`, `previewValue` when it throws), `AppIntentControlConfiguration` (`AppIntentControlValueProvider`; `ControlConfigurationIntent`), `ControlWidgetButton(action:)`, `ControlWidgetToggle(isOn:action:)` with a `SetValueIntent` (given the new value), labels (`Label` title and SF Symbol, value label, `tint`, `controlWidgetActionHint`), `displayName` / `description`; `ControlCenter.shared.reloadControls(ofKind:)` / `reloadAllControls()` / `currentControls()`. The system draws the controls (iOS 18 layout, 26/27 glass): Control Center edit mode (+): remove badges, 1x1 / 2x1 resize, "Add a Control" gallery (the apps' controls by app, plus system controls: Flashlight, Timer, Dark Mode, Camera, Low Power Mode, which `ProcessInfo.isLowPowerModeEnabled` and its notification follow); a tap runs the intent in the extension process and shows the new state. The Lock Screen's two buttons and the Action button (iPhone 15 Pro and later presets; default Silent Mode) run any control (script `lockcontrol`, `actionbutton`). Not on isim: moving modules in edit mode, per-control configuration UI (default intent parameters), push-updated controls, the Lock Screen / Action button choice in a UI (script only). Tested (cc_controls) |
| Entity properties: `EntityProperty` (`@Property(title:)`, `AppEntity.Property`; `identifier:`), `EntityPropertyModifiers`, `@ComputedProperty()` / `(title:)` (iOS 26) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: the metadata lists each entity type's properties and titles (Shortcuts' "Get Details"); `@ComputedProperty` is accepted but not listed. Not yet: the `indexingKey:` / `customIndexingKey:` (Spotlight) and `getter:` / `asyncGetter:` initializers. Tested (HelloBookshelfIntents, test_bookshelf_intents.py) |
| `EntityPropertyQuery` (`QueryProperties` / `EntityQueryProperties`, `Property` / `EntityQueryProperty`, `EqualToComparator`, `NotEqualToComparator`, `LessThan…`, `GreaterThan…`, `ContainsComparator`, `HasPrefixComparator`, `HasSuffixComparator`, `IsBetweenComparator`, `SortingOptions` / `SortableBy`, `EntityQuerySort`, `EntityQueryComparatorMode`, `findIntentDescription`) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: the metadata lists the filterable properties, their comparators and the sort options; a "find" request (Shortcuts' "Find … where …") turns each (property, comparator, value) into the query's `ComparatorMappingType` and calls `entities(matching:mode:sortedBy:limit:)`. Not yet: `withResolvers:` comparators. Tested (HelloBookshelfIntents, test_bookshelf_intents.py) |
| `@Dependency` (`AppDependency`), `AppDependencyManager` (`add(key:dependency:)`, the three forms; `Error`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: each dependency is made once, when first read; async makers and `default:` closures run on a separate task while the reader waits. Tested (HelloBookshelfIntents: intents, queries and the app read one Library) |
| Parameter summaries: `parameterSummary`, `Summary` (`IntentParameterSummary`, with the parameters listed under it), `When` (`ParameterSummaryWhenCondition`: equatable, comparable, has-value and one-of conditions), `ParameterSummaryString`, `ParameterSummaryBuilder` | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: the sentence (parameters as `${name}`) and the listed parameters go into the metadata, resolved for the intent's current values. Not yet: `Switch` / `Case`, `identifier:` and `widgetFamily:` conditions. Tested (HelloBookshelfIntents, test_bookshelf_intents.py) |
| `DynamicOptionsProvider` (`@Parameter(title:optionsProvider:)`), `ResultsCollection`, `IntentItemCollection`, `IntentItemSection`, `IntentItem` (and their builders) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: Siri and Shortcuts offer the provider's values (titles, subtitles; sections flattened) instead of the type's defaults. Tested (HelloBookshelfIntents: the shelf choices) |
| `AppIntentError` (`restartPerform`, `Unrecoverable`, `UserActionRequired`, `PermissionRequired`, `init(description:)`, `init(predefinedError:description:)`, `init(wrapping:)`), `CustomAppIntentErrorConvertible` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: the error's message is the failure dialog; `restartPerform` runs `perform()` again (up to 4 times). Tested (HelloBookshelfIntents) |
| `IntentPerson`, `IntentFile`, `IntentCurrencyAmount` parameters and results | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: Siri and Shortcuts read a person as "Name <email or phone>", a file as a path on the device, an amount as "12.50 USD" or "$12.50"; results show their description. Not yet: the contact picker, `ParameterMode`, transfer representations. Tested (HelloBookshelfIntents: Lend Book) |
